question: Deficiency of ________ induces a disorder known as kwashiorkor.
solution:
Correct answer is__** Protein.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The main reason for kwashiorkor is **not eating sufficient protein or other crucial vitamins and minerals**. 
 
• Kwashiorkor is a form of **acute malnutrition **that happens due to **protein deficiency**.
 
• Severe protein deficiency can lead to fluid retention, which can make the **stomach look bloated**.
 
• The best treatment to stop malnutrition is to **eat a healthy, balanced diet**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88d1e854a37cb1a90ac6c7821a2529ad1bcbe83806646677505dc4195158cbc9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Marasmus is caused by the deficiency of all the **nutrients or minerals.**
 
• If a person doesn't get sufficient dietary fat, it could affect the health of his** skin and lead to dermatitis**. 
 
• **Marasmus** happens due to a deficiency of **carbohydrates, fats, and proteins** in the diet, and mainly affects infants** below the age of one year.**
